examples.english: The contract's wording was ambiguous about who owned the patent.
examples.persian: متن قرارداد درباره‌ی مالکیت حق اختراع مبهم بود.

examples.english: Her reply was deliberately ambiguous, leaving both sides hopeful.
examples.persian: پاسخ او عمداً مبهم بود و هر دو طرف را امیدوار رها کرد.

examples.english: The poem's final line remains ambiguous even after decades of scholarship.
examples.persian: سطر پایانی شعر حتی پس از دهه‌ها بررسی پژوهشی همچنان مبهم باقی مانده است.

miniContext: Diplomats sometimes choose language that is deliberately ambiguous when no side will accept a clear commitment. An ambiguous clause can keep talks alive precisely because each party reads it the way it prefers. Years later, when the ambiguity finally has to be resolved, both sides often discover they agreed to very different things.

examples.english: The prosecutor built a compelling case from a handful of scattered clues.
examples.persian: دادستان از چند سرنخ پراکنده یک پرونده‌ی بسیار قانع‌کننده ساخت.

examples.english: Her memoir offers a compelling account of life under occupation.
examples.persian: خاطرات او روایتی بسیار قانع‌کننده از زندگی زیر اشغال ارائه می‌دهد.

examples.english: Nothing about the advertisement felt compelling enough to change her mind.
examples.persian: هیچ‌چیز در آن تبلیغ به‌قدری قانع‌کننده نبود که نظر او را تغییر دهد.

miniContext: A documentary succeeds not by presenting the most facts but by telling the most compelling story out of them. Editors spend months searching hours of footage for the handful of compelling scenes that will hold an audience's attention. Without that compelling thread, even the most important subject can feel unwatchable.

examples.english: The report offers a comprehensive review of the country's energy policy.
examples.persian: این گزارش بررسی جامعی از سیاست انرژی کشور ارائه می‌دهد.

examples.english: She underwent a comprehensive medical exam before the expedition.
examples.persian: او پیش از اکسپدیشن تحت معاینه‌ی پزشکی جامعی قرار گرفت.

examples.english: The museum's comprehensive collection spans five centuries of regional art.
examples.persian: مجموعه‌ی جامع موزه پنج قرن از هنر منطقه‌ای را در بر می‌گیرد.

miniContext: Writing a truly comprehensive history of the city meant combing through tax records, letters, and court documents that most historians had ignored for a century. The author rejected any draft that left out an inconvenient chapter, insisting the book remain comprehensive even where the story was unflattering. Reviewers later called it the first comprehensive account the city had ever had.

examples.english: The renovation required a considerable amount of money and time.
examples.persian: بازسازی به مقدار قابل‌توجهی از پول و زمان نیاز داشت.

examples.english: She has considerable influence over the committee's final decisions.
examples.persian: او بر تصمیمات نهایی کمیته نفوذ قابل‌توجهی دارد.

examples.english: There was considerable disagreement among scientists about the cause of the extinction.
examples.persian: میان دانشمندان درباره‌ی علت آن انقراض، اختلاف‌نظر قابل‌توجهی وجود داشت.

miniContext: Restoring the cathedral's ceiling took considerable skill, since centuries of smoke and damp had blurred details no photograph could fully capture. The project also demanded a considerable budget, far beyond what the original estimate had suggested. By the time scaffolding finally came down, the considerable effort had taken almost a decade.

examples.english: The mayor's plan to close the park remains highly controversial among residents.
examples.persian: طرح شهردار برای بستن پارک همچنان در میان ساکنان بسیار بحث‌برانگیز است.

examples.english: The novel's controversial ending divided critics when it was first published.
examples.persian: پایان بحث‌برانگیز رمان هنگام انتشار اولش منتقدان را دودسته کرد.

examples.english: He made a controversial decision to resign just weeks before the election.
examples.persian: او تصمیم بحث‌برانگیزی گرفت و تنها چند هفته پیش از انتخابات استعفا داد.

miniContext: Few theories in the field have remained as controversial for as long as the one proposing that the collapse was caused by climate, not war. Each new excavation reignites the controversial debate rather than settling it. Scholars on both sides admit that the question may stay controversial for another generation.

examples.english: She abandoned conventional farming methods in favor of a no-till approach.
examples.persian: او روش‌های متعارف کشاورزی را کنار گذاشت و به سوی روشی بدون شخم رفت.

examples.english: The building's design breaks sharply from conventional architecture of its era.
examples.persian: طراحی این بنا به‌شدت از معماری متعارف دوران خود فاصله می‌گیرد.

examples.english: His conventional upbringing left little room for questioning family tradition.
examples.persian: تربیت متعارف او جایی برای پرسش درباره‌ی سنت خانوادگی باقی نمی‌گذاشت.

miniContext: Conventional wisdom held that the desert soil could never support a vineyard, yet within a decade the region was exporting wine across the continent. Breaking with conventional methods meant years of failed harvests before the new technique finally worked. Once it succeeded, what had seemed reckless became, for neighboring farms, the new conventional approach.

examples.english: Early diagnosis is crucial for surviving this type of cancer.
examples.persian: تشخیص زودهنگام برای زنده ماندن از این نوع سرطان بسیار مهم است.

examples.english: The bridge played a crucial role in supplying the besieged city.
examples.persian: پل نقشی بسیار مهم در تأمین آن شهر محصور ایفا کرد.

examples.english: Her testimony proved crucial in overturning his earlier conviction.
examples.persian: شهادت او در لغو محکومیت پیشین او نقشی بسیار مهم داشت.

miniContext: The last hour before the storm made landfall proved crucial, since every evacuation decided in that window saved lives that would otherwise have been lost. Emergency planners now treat that crucial window as the single most important variable in any hurricane response. Missing it, even by minutes, can turn a manageable evacuation into a tragedy.

examples.english: Surgeons face a demanding schedule, often working through the night.
examples.persian: جراحان با برنامه‌ای چالش‌برانگیز روبه‌رو هستند و اغلب تا شب کار می‌کنند.

examples.english: The expedition proved far more demanding than any of the climbers had expected.
examples.persian: اکسپدیشن بسیار چالش‌برانگیزتر از آنچه کوهنوردان انتظار داشتند از آب درآمد.

examples.english: Her mentor was demanding but fair, pushing every student past their comfort zone.
examples.persian: استادش چالش‌برانگیز اما منصف بود و هر دانشجو را فراتر از منطقه‌ی امنش می‌برد.

miniContext: Ballet is one of the most physically demanding art forms, requiring years of training before a dancer's body can even attempt the simplest lift. Choreographers who are especially demanding often produce the performances audiences remember longest. Dancers rarely resent a demanding rehearsal once they see what it makes possible on stage.

examples.english: The lawyer remained discreet about the details of the settlement.
examples.persian: وکیل درباره‌ی جزئیات توافق، محتاط و رازدار باقی ماند.

examples.english: She made a discreet exit before the argument could escalate further.
examples.persian: او پیش از آنکه دعوا شدت بیشتری بگیرد، به‌طور محتاطانه و بی‌سروصدا بیرون رفت.

examples.english: The hotel staff were trained to be discreet about their famous guests.
examples.persian: کارکنان هتل آموزش دیده بودند تا درباره‌ی مهمانان مشهور خود محتاط و رازدار باشند.

miniContext: Royal aides are expected to be discreet about matters that would make headlines elsewhere, since a single careless remark can embarrass an entire institution. The most trusted staff are not necessarily the most talented, but the most discreet, able to carry a secret for decades without a slip. In that world, discretion is treated as a far rarer skill than loyalty itself.

examples.english: The rainforest supports an extraordinarily diverse range of insect species.
examples.persian: جنگل بارانی طیف بی‌اندازه متنوعی از گونه‌های حشرات را در خود جای داده است.

examples.english: The city's population has grown far more diverse over the past thirty years.
examples.persian: جمعیت شهر طی سی سال گذشته بسیار متنوع‌تر شده است.

examples.english: Her musical influences are remarkably diverse, from folk to free jazz.
examples.persian: تأثیرات موسیقایی او به‌طور قابل‌توجهی متنوع است، از موسیقی فولک تا جاز آزاد.

miniContext: A reef can look uniform from above, yet beneath the surface it supports a diverse community of species found nowhere else on the planet. Marine biologists argue that this diversity, not sheer size, is what makes a reef worth protecting. Lose a reef's diverse inhabitants, and the structure left behind is little more than dead stone.

examples.english: The palace ceiling features an elaborate mural depicting the empire's founding.
examples.persian: سقف کاخ دارای یک دیوارنگاره‌ی مفصل و پرجزئیات از بنیان‌گذاری امپراتوری است.

examples.english: She devised an elaborate plan to smuggle the documents across the border.
examples.persian: او نقشه‌ای مفصل برای قاچاق اسناد از مرز طراحی کرد.

examples.english: The wedding involved an elaborate ceremony lasting three full days.
examples.persian: عروسی شامل تشریفاتی مفصل و پرجزئیات بود که سه روز تمام طول کشید.

miniContext: The spy's cover story was so elaborate that even colleagues who worked alongside him for years never suspected his real identity. Building an elaborate false history took months of forged documents and rehearsed details. In the end, it was not the elaborate plan that failed, but one small, unplanned coincidence.

examples.english: The young violinist showed exceptional talent from her very first lesson.
examples.persian: آن ویولن‌نواز نوجوان از همان نخستین جلسه‌اش استعدادی استثنایی نشان داد.

examples.english: Only in exceptional circumstances will the court grant an extension.
examples.persian: دادگاه تنها در شرایط استثنایی مهلت اضافه خواهد داد.

examples.english: His exceptional memory for faces made him invaluable to the investigation.
examples.persian: حافظه‌ی استثنایی او برای چهره‌ها، او را برای تحقیقات بسیار ارزشمند کرد.

miniContext: Scouts travel to remote villages for years hoping to find one exceptional player among thousands of ordinary ones. What marks a talent as truly exceptional is rarely raw skill alone but the instinct to use it under pressure. Even coaches who have seen hundreds of promising children still remember the handful who were genuinely exceptional.

examples.english: The contract contains an explicit clause forbidding any subletting.
examples.persian: قرارداد شامل بندی صریح است که هرگونه اجاره‌ی مجدد را ممنوع می‌کند.

examples.english: She gave explicit instructions not to disturb her before noon.
examples.persian: او دستورالعملی صریح داد که پیش از ظهر مزاحمش نشوند.

examples.english: The report made no explicit mention of who had approved the budget.
examples.persian: گزارش هیچ اشاره‌ی صریحی به اینکه چه کسی بودجه را تصویب کرده بود، نکرد.

miniContext: Treaties that leave key terms vague often collapse within a generation, which is why modern negotiators insist on language that is explicit rather than merely implied. An explicit boundary line, however unwelcome to one side, tends to prevent far more conflict than a diplomatic ambiguity ever could. Lawyers are trained to notice exactly where a document stops being explicit and starts leaving room for dispute.

examples.english: The company now offers flexible working hours for new parents.
examples.persian: شرکت اکنون ساعات کاری انعطاف‌پذیری برای والدین تازه‌کار ارائه می‌دهد.

examples.english: Bamboo is flexible enough to bend in a storm without snapping.
examples.persian: بامبو به‌قدری انعطاف‌پذیر است که در طوفان خم می‌شود بدون آنکه بشکند.

examples.english: Her flexible approach to teaching let each student learn at their own pace.
examples.persian: رویکرد انعطاف‌پذیر او در تدریس به هر دانش‌آموز اجازه می‌داد با سرعت خودش یاد بگیرد.

miniContext: Engineers studying earthquake damage noticed that buildings designed to be flexible, swaying slightly rather than resisting the shock outright, survived far better than rigid ones. A skyscraper built with flexible joints can bend several feet at the top without a single crack forming at the base. That same lesson, architects say, applies well beyond construction: systems that stay flexible under stress tend to outlast those built only for strength.

examples.english: Trust is fundamental to any lasting partnership, business or personal.
examples.persian: اعتماد برای هر مشارکت پایدار، چه تجاری و چه شخصی، اساسی است.

examples.english: The discovery challenged a fundamental assumption in evolutionary biology.
examples.persian: این کشف یک فرض اساسی در زیست‌شناسی تطبیقی را به چالش کشید.

examples.english: Access to clean water is a fundamental right, not a privilege.
examples.persian: دسترسی به آب پاک یک حق اساسی است، نه یک امتیاز.

miniContext: Before any student is allowed to study advanced physics, they must master a handful of fundamental laws that govern everything from falling apples to orbiting planets. Skipping those fundamental principles makes later material feel like memorized magic rather than understood science. Teachers who rush past the fundamentals often produce students who can calculate but cannot explain why.

examples.english: Her genuine concern for the refugees was obvious to everyone who met her.
examples.persian: دغدغه‌ی واقعی و صادقانه‌ی او برای پناهجویان برای هر کسی که او را می‌دید آشکار بود.

examples.english: Experts confirmed the manuscript was a genuine fifteenth-century original.
examples.persian: کارشناسان تأیید کردند که آن دست‌نوشته یک نسخه‌ی اصلی و واقعی از قرن پانزدهم است.

examples.english: It takes a genuine apology, not a rehearsed one, to repair that kind of damage.
examples.persian: برای ترمیم چنین آسیبی، یک عذرخواهی واقعی و صادقانه لازم است، نه یک عذرخواهی تمرین‌شده.

miniContext: Child psychologists say that infants can sense the difference between a genuine smile and a forced one long before they can speak. A genuine response, unlike a performed one, tends to involve the whole face, not just the mouth. Learning to recognize what is genuine in another person, researchers argue, may be one of the oldest instincts we have.

examples.english: The glacier's retreat has been gradual but unmistakable over the past fifty years.
examples.persian: عقب‌نشینی یخچال طی پنجاه سال گذشته تدریجی اما غیرقابل‌انکار بوده است.

examples.english: Her recovery from the surgery was gradual, taking the better part of a year.
examples.persian: بهبودی او از آن جراحی تدریجی بود و تقریباً یک سال طول کشید.

examples.english: The village experienced a gradual shift from farming to tourism over two generations.
examples.persian: روستا طی دو نسل تغییری تدریجی از کشاورزی به گردشگری را تجربه کرد.

miniContext: Erosion rarely announces itself; a cliff that looks solid for decades can collapse only after years of gradual, invisible weakening underground. Geologists studying the coastline track that gradual loss in millimeters per year, numbers too small for a casual visitor to notice. By the time the change becomes obvious, the gradual process that caused it has usually been underway for generations.

examples.english: Given the rising debt, economists considered a recession inevitable.
examples.persian: با توجه به افزایش بدهی، اقتصاددانان رکود را اجتناب‌ناپذیر می‌دانستند.

examples.english: His resignation seemed inevitable after the scandal broke.
examples.persian: پس از افشای رسوایی، استعفای او اجتناب‌ناپذیر به نظر می‌رسید.

examples.english: Change in the old industry was inevitable once automation became affordable.
examples.persian: پس از اینکه اتوماسیون ارزان‌تر شد، تغییر در آن صنعت قدیمی اجتناب‌ناپذیر بود.

miniContext: By the final year of the siege, defeat had come to feel inevitable even to the soldiers still manning the walls. Historians later argued that nothing about the outcome was truly inevitable, and that a handful of different decisions might have changed everything. Yet to the people living through it, every sign pointed to an ending that felt, at the time, impossible to avoid.

examples.english: The philosopher remains one of the most influential thinkers of the century.
examples.persian: آن فیلسوف همچنان یکی از تاثیرگذارترین اندیشمندان آن قرن است.

examples.english: Her research proved highly influential in shaping climate policy worldwide.
examples.persian: پژوهش او در شکل‌دادن به سیاست‌های جهانی آب‌وهوایی بسیار تاثیرگذار بود.

examples.english: A single influential critic can make or break a young novelist's career.
examples.persian: یک منتقد تاثیرگذار به‌تنهایی می‌تواند مسیر حرفه‌ای یک رمان‌نویس جوان را بسازد یا نابود کند.

miniContext: The pamphlet sold only a few hundred copies in its first year, yet it became one of the most influential documents of the revolution. Historians still debate why a text so obscure at the time grew so influential decades later. Influence, it turns out, is rarely measured at the moment a work first appears.

examples.english: The startup's innovative approach to recycling attracted investors worldwide.
examples.persian: رویکرد نوآورانه‌ی آن استارتاپ به بازیافت، سرمایه‌گذارانی از سراسر جهان را جذب کرد.

examples.english: Her innovative use of color changed the direction of the entire movement.
examples.persian: استفاده‌ی نوآورانه‌ی او از رنگ، مسیر کل آن جنبش هنری را تغییر داد.

examples.english: The hospital adopted an innovative treatment that halved recovery time.
examples.persian: بیمارستان روشی نوآورانه‌ی درمانی را پذیرفت که زمان بهبودی را به نصف رساند.

miniContext: What made the architect's design so innovative was not any single new material but the way she combined old techniques nobody had thought to put together. Critics initially dismissed the building as reckless rather than innovative. Within a decade, however, the same innovative ideas were showing up in cities across the world.

examples.english: The delay appeared intentional, designed to frustrate the opposing lawyers.
examples.persian: تأخیر عمدی به نظر می‌رسید و هدفش ناکام گذاشتن وکلای مقابل بود.

examples.english: Her every word choice in the speech felt intentional, nothing left to chance.
examples.persian: انتخاب هر کلمه در سخنرانی او عمدی به نظر می‌رسید، هیچ‌چیز به شانس سپرده نشده بود.

examples.english: Investigators had to determine whether the leak was intentional or accidental.
examples.persian: بازرسان باید مشخص می‌کردند که آن نشت اطلاعات عمدی بوده یا تصادفی.

miniContext: Not every pause in a great speech is intentional, but the best speakers learn to make silence look as deliberate as any sentence. A director who leaves a shot unresolved is often making an intentional choice, trusting the audience to sit with discomfort rather than explaining it away. Over time, audiences learn to trust that what feels intentional in a work usually is.

examples.english: Her argument followed a logical sequence that even skeptics found hard to dismiss.
examples.persian: استدلال او توالی منطقی‌ای داشت که حتی شکاکان هم به‌سختی می‌توانستند آن را رد کنند.

examples.english: It seemed logical to evacuate the coast before the storm made landfall.
examples.persian: تخلیه‌ی ساحل پیش از رسیدن طوفان به خشکی، منطقی به نظر می‌رسید.

examples.english: The detective's logical approach eliminated every suspect but one.
examples.persian: رویکرد منطقی کارآگاه همه‌ی مظنونان جز یک نفر را کنار گذاشت.

miniContext: A proof in mathematics must be logical at every single step, since a single gap invalidates everything that follows from it. Students often confuse a logical argument with a merely plausible one, forgetting that plausibility is not proof. Philosophers have spent centuries arguing over whether human reasoning is even naturally logical, or whether logic itself had to be invented.

examples.english: The exhibit includes several notable works by local painters.
examples.persian: این نمایشگاه شامل چندین اثر قابل‌توجه از نقاشان محلی است.

examples.english: With one notable exception, every witness agreed on the timeline.
examples.persian: به‌جز یک استثنای قابل‌توجه، همه‌ی شاهدان درباره‌ی زمان‌بندی توافق داشتند.

examples.english: Her notable absence from the ceremony raised questions among the guests.
examples.persian: غیبت قابل‌توجه او در آن مراسم، میان مهمانان سؤال‌برانگیز شد.

miniContext: Among the hundreds of graduates that year, only a notable few went on to shape the field in any lasting way. Historians often single out one notable figure per generation, even though progress usually depends on dozens of less celebrated contributors. The notable names survive in textbooks; the rest survive only in footnotes, if at all.

examples.english: The referee is expected to remain objective, regardless of which team the crowd favors.
examples.persian: داور باید بی‌طرف و عینی باقی بماند، بدون توجه به اینکه تماشاگران از کدام تیم طرفداری می‌کنند.

examples.english: She tried to give an objective account of the meeting, free of her own opinions.
examples.persian: او تلاش کرد روایتی عینی و بی‌طرف از جلسه ارائه دهد، بدون دخالت نظرات شخصی‌اش.

examples.english: Journalists are trained to stay objective even when covering their own community.
examples.persian: روزنامه‌نگاران آموزش می‌بینند حتی هنگام پوشش خبری جامعه‌ی خودشان هم بی‌طرف و عینی باقی بمانند.

miniContext: A good juror is asked to be objective in a case that may touch on a crime committed in their own neighborhood. Scientists, too, work hard to stay objective about results from experiments they have spent years designing, since hope can quietly bend interpretation. Complete objectivity may be impossible, but the discipline of trying to be objective is what separates careful judgment from mere opinion.

examples.english: Despite repeated rejections, she remained persistent in pursuing the grant.
examples.persian: او با وجود ردهای پی‌درپی، در پیگیری آن بودجه‌ی پژوهشی پیگیر و مداوم ماند.

examples.english: A persistent cough sent him back to the doctor after three weeks.
examples.persian: یک سرفه‌ی مداوم پس از سه هفته او را دوباره پیش دکتر فرستاد.

examples.english: The village faced persistent flooding every rainy season for a decade.
examples.persian: روستا برای یک دهه هر فصل باران با سیل مداوم و پیگیر مواجه بود.

miniContext: Journalists who break major stories are rarely the most talented writers in the newsroom, but they are often the most persistent, willing to make the fortieth phone call that a source finally answers. A persistent reporter treats a closed door as a temporary obstacle rather than a final answer. That same persistent habit, colleagues note, is as exhausting to work alongside as it is effective.

examples.english: The committee preferred a practical solution over an elegant but costly one.
examples.persian: کمیته راه‌حلی عملی را به راه‌حلی شیک اما پرهزینه ترجیح داد.

examples.english: Her practical advice about visas saved us weeks of confusion.
examples.persian: توصیه‌ی عملی او درباره‌ی ویزا هفته‌ها سردرگمی ما را از بین برد.

examples.english: There is no practical way to transport the statue without damaging it.
examples.persian: هیچ راه عملی‌ای برای انتقال آن مجسمه بدون آسیب رساندن به آن وجود ندارد.

miniContext: Engineers often admire a design for its elegance, but a bridge still has to be practical enough to build with the budget and materials actually on hand. The firm that won the contract was not the most imaginative, but the most practical, proposing a plan that could be finished before the rainy season began. Beauty mattered less, in the end, than a practical schedule the client could trust.

examples.english: The surgeon's precise movements left almost no visible scar.
examples.persian: حرکات دقیق جراح تقریباً هیچ جای زخم قابل‌مشاهده‌ای باقی نگذاشت.

examples.english: Astronomers need precise measurements to track the asteroid's path.
examples.persian: ستاره‌شناسان برای ردیابی مسیر آن سیارک به اندازه‌گیری‌های دقیق نیاز دارند.

examples.english: She could not recall the precise date, only that it was sometime in spring.
examples.persian: او نتوانست تاریخ دقیق را به خاطر بیاورد، فقط می‌دانست جایی در بهار بوده است.

miniContext: Watchmakers once spent entire careers perfecting a single precise mechanism small enough to fit in a pocket. A clock accurate to within a second a day was once considered remarkably precise; modern atomic clocks lose a second only once in millions of years. That relentless pursuit of being more precise has quietly reshaped navigation, finance, and science far beyond timekeeping.

examples.english: The lawyer objected that the question was not relevant to the case.
examples.persian: وکیل اعتراض کرد که آن پرسش به پرونده مرتبط نیست.

examples.english: Only three of the twenty documents turned out to be relevant to the investigation.
examples.persian: تنها سه سند از بیست سند به تحقیقات مرتبط از آب درآمدند.

examples.english: Her decades-old research suddenly became relevant again during the outbreak.
examples.persian: پژوهش چنددهه‌قدیمی او در طول شیوع بیماری دوباره مرتبط شد.

miniContext: A library's challenge is not finding information but filtering out everything that is not relevant to a given question. Search engines now rank results by trying to guess what a user considers relevant, often without the user realizing the choice was made for them. A source that was relevant a decade ago can become outdated overnight once new evidence appears.

examples.english: The charity received a substantial donation from an anonymous benefactor.
examples.persian: آن خیریه کمک مالی قابل‌توجه و چشمگیری از یک خیرخواه ناشناس دریافت کرد.

examples.english: There is substantial evidence linking the chemical to long-term health problems.
examples.persian: شواهد قابل‌توجه و چشمگیری وجود دارد که آن ماده‌ی شیمیایی را به مشکلات سلامتی بلندمدت مرتبط می‌کند.

examples.english: The new policy made a substantial difference in reducing traffic accidents.
examples.persian: سیاست جدید تفاوت قابل‌توجه و چشمگیری در کاهش تصادفات رانندگی ایجاد کرد.

miniContext: Rebuilding the dam required a substantial investment that the small province could never have raised alone. Engineers warned that anything less than a substantial reinforcement would leave the structure vulnerable to the next flood. When the funding finally arrived, it was, by any measure, substantial enough to finish the job properly.

examples.english: The inspector conducted a thorough review of every safety exit in the building.
examples.persian: بازرس بررسی کامل و دقیقی از تمام خروجی‌های ایمنی ساختمان انجام داد.

examples.english: Her thorough research uncovered documents the previous historian had overlooked.
examples.persian: پژوهش کامل و دقیق او اسنادی را کشف کرد که مورخ پیشین از قلم انداخته بود.

examples.english: A thorough cleaning of the wound reduced the risk of infection significantly.
examples.persian: تمیزکاری کامل و دقیق زخم خطر عفونت را به‌طور قابل‌توجهی کاهش داد.

miniContext: Before approving the new drug, regulators demanded a thorough review of every trial the company had ever run, not just the favorable ones. A less thorough agency might have missed the one dataset that revealed a rare but serious side effect. It was precisely that thorough, unglamorous scrutiny that caught the problem before the drug ever reached a pharmacy shelf.
